findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false and the same key material is used indefinitely. This increases the blast radius of a compromised key and violates common key-management requirements for long-lived log encryption keys.

No key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy that grants the account root full control over the key, effectively allowing any IAM principal in the account that can be granted kms:* permissions to use or manage this key. A least-privilege key policy restricting decrypt/administer rights to specific principals is absent.
